failure_causes.finding: Two reference checks captured empty protected application log output with exit_code=0: the sidecar marker in restricted-init-sidecar and the cache marker in already-secure-cache. Their behavior checks failed, so process probes were intentionally skipped and probe coverage also failed.

historical_diagnostic_audit.note: 48/48 internally consistent observations does not mean 48 passing reference controls. The worker failed on two unexpected oracle failures; all original flags are preserved.

scope: Three completed real Kubernetes reference-validation pilots only. No models were executed in these pilots. Pilot 04 is intentionally excluded until its result is observed.
score_policy: All original artifacts, flags and failed run conclusions are preserved. Diagnostic audits explain evidence consistency under historical contracts; they neither rescore the originals nor qualify a newer frozen protocol.

time_definitions.sum_observed_job_seconds: Sum of actual protocol and validate job durations from the preserved GitHub job ledger. This is runner work, not a separate workflow wall-clock measurement.
time_definitions.sum_per_job_rounded_runner_minutes: Sum of ceil(job_seconds/60), excluding skipped zero-duration jobs; conservative budget proxy, not GitHub billing data.
time_definitions.worker_elapsed_seconds: Original summary.json seconds; includes setup, controls and worker cleanup.
